verdict.rationale: Metorial provides a documented public REST API (openapi.json live, api.metorial.com verified via probe with key-gated Bearer auth matching docs), plus official TypeScript/Python/Go SDKs, quickstart docs, error handling, API key management, and sandbox/production environments. Runtime probes confirm the API is live and behaves exactly as documented. Missing for 10: no independent third-party review of API completeness/versioning beyond vendor docs and probes.
